environment.description: Deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The Envoy listener filter chain includes a Lua filter that appends response headers. The task definition specifies a containerPort 8080 mapped only to the Envoy sidecar's upstream cluster (not exposed externally). Envoy's route configuration includes a response_headers_to_add directive that sets 'Content-Security-Policy' to 'default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\' https://cdn.example.com; style-src \'self\'; object-src \'none\'; base-uri \'self\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'' on ALL responses regardless of backend behavior. The Envoy Lua filter additionally strips any CSP headers originating from the upstream before applying its own. External traffic reaches Envoy on port 443 via an NLB with TLS termination at Envoy. Note: the CSP does NOT include 'unsafe-inline' for script-src, and does not specify any nonce or hash that would permit inline script execution.

config.runtime: Go 1.21 binary in ECS Fargate container
config.sidecar: Envoy 1.28 with Lua response header filter
config.csp_header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
config.lua_filter: strips upstream Content-Security-Policy headers before applying Envoy-managed CSP
config.network: containerPort 8080 only accessible within task networking namespace; external via NLB:443 -> Envoy:8443
